# HTML2Text v0.3.0 - Table of Contents

## Pages

- [README](https://html2text.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [HTML2Text](https://html2text.hexdocs.pm/HTML2Text.md): A high-performance HTML to text converter using Rust NIF.
- [HTML2Text.HTML](https://html2text.hexdocs.pm/HTML2Text.HTML.md): A container for HTML content with rich terminal inspection.

- Exceptions
  - [HTML2Text.Error](https://html2text.hexdocs.pm/HTML2Text.Error.md): Exception raised by bang functions (`convert!/2`, `convert_rich!/2`).
